title: Forcing Function
governance_note: The external input should be justified and documented.

title: Impulse Shock
governance_note: Impulse shocks should document timing, magnitude, duration, units, and time-scale assumptions.

title: Step Change
governance_note: Step changes should distinguish temporary disturbance from persistent new conditions.

title: Shock Response
governance_note: Response metrics should define deviation, recovery time, cumulative loss, or threshold crossing.

title: Shock Governance
governance_note: Shock scenarios should be labeled as stress tests unless evidence supports forecast claims.
